olympic.overview: Surfing the rugged Washington coast means cold water and heavy beach breaks. La Push First Beach and Rialto Beach offer powerful waves for intermediate and expert surfers when Pacific storms deliver swell from September to March. Beginners will find the strong rips, driftwood hazards, and freezing water too dangerous.
